sections.advice: Freudenstadt → Triberg is 49 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Triberg → Titisee is 33 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Titisee → Feldberg climbs about 1231 m in 15 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Feldberg → Waldshut drops about 1231 m over 40 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Black Forest Panorama Route B500 South
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 33 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

facts.v: Black Forest Panorama Route B500 South

scenicChapters.title: Black Forest Panorama Route B500 South
scenicChapters.narrative: First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding. The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 8.4%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Feldberg → Waldshut
scenicChapters.narrative: 41 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

black-forest-panorama-route-b500-south.story: 138 km one way from Freudenstadt - plan on about 2 h 15 of riding. It goes by way of Triberg, Titisee and Feldberg. The highest point is about 1,250 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
